summary: Short, very steep kerb beside a mapped house, church and offices.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 7 m, church 6 m and offices 13-14 m from the kerb; rail corridor further south.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with cars parked on this kerb; room only for a few vehicles, and the slope is too steep.
drivers.traffic: Short side street near a junction and commercial buildings.
drivers.convention: Three cars parked on this kerb, but no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the south end shade the lower part in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the detached building is a home or church property
